# TechOptyx — Earn as you Learn

> TechOptyx is a comprehensive builder operating system and interactive curriculum designed to help creators, developers, and entrepreneurs master AI full-stack development, AI video animation, and digital marketing while monetizing their work from Phase 1.

Website: https://ais-pre-lbq5lkbylbppscqlpr6ota-504961274447.europe-west2.run.app
Full LLM Documentation: https://ais-pre-lbq5lkbylbppscqlpr6ota-504961274447.europe-west2.run.app/llms-full.txt
Sitemap: https://ais-pre-lbq5lkbylbppscqlpr6ota-504961274447.europe-west2.run.app/sitemap.xml

## Core Tracks

- [AI & Full-Stack Development](https://ais-pre-lbq5lkbylbppscqlpr6ota-504961274447.europe-west2.run.app/tracks/ai-fullstack): 14 practical phases taking learners from digital fundamentals, Python, and TypeScript to building LLM apps with LangChain, LangGraph, RAG pipelines, fine-tuning, and multi-agent systems. Every phase includes a sellable client deliverable.
- [AI Video Animation & Generation](https://ais-pre-lbq5lkbylbppscqlpr6ota-504961274447.europe-west2.run.app/tracks/video-animation): 10 progressive modules covering Midjourney, Flux, Runway Gen-3, Kling, Pika, ElevenLabs voice cloning, lip sync with Hedra/LivePortrait, and commercial video monetization.
- [Digital Marketing & Growth](https://ais-pre-lbq5lkbylbppscqlpr6ota-504961274447.europe-west2.run.app/tracks/digital-marketing): 10 execution phases teaching brand strategy, SEO & AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), paid social acquisition (Meta & TikTok Ads), email automation, conversion rate optimization (CRO), and client retainers.

## Key Features

- **Sellable Deliverables in Every Phase**: Unlike passive tutorials, each phase requires building a specific product or service with market pricing and outreach scripts.
- **Industry Certifications Directory**: Curated free and recognized certification pathways from Google, DeepLearning.AI, AWS, Meta, and HubSpot.
- **Battle-Tested Prompt Library**: 50+ tested, copy-paste prompts across SaaS validation, code refactoring, copywriting, Midjourney art, and marketing.
- **AI Path Assistant**: Interactive in-browser AI mentor powered by Gemini models for real-time code reviews, project feedback, and sales strategy.
- **Installable PWA**: Works offline and installs as a native mobile and desktop Progressive Web App.
